name: Framer
summary: Explore Framer's dark Design design system: Void #000000, Graphite #111111 colors, sans-serif, GT Walsheim typography, and DESIGN.md for AI agents.

colors.name: Void
colors.role: Page canvas, nav background, card surfaces, icon fills - the infinite black that swallows all non-essential content

colors.name: Graphite
colors.role: Elevated card surfaces one step above the void - large feature cards and modal containers

colors.name: Obsidian
colors.role: Mid-tier surface for buttons, secondary cards, UI fills - separates interactive elements from the canvas

colors.name: Slate
colors.role: Hover states, input fields, and elevated panels - the brightest neutral before reaching text territory

colors.name: Ash
colors.role: Deep fill for inactive backgrounds and structural elements

colors.name: Smoke
colors.role: Disabled text, low-emphasis body copy, tertiary strokes

colors.name: Fog
colors.role: Borders, dividers, icon strokes - the structural outline color

colors.name: Mist
colors.role: Secondary body text, captions, metadata - readable but never competing with headlines

colors.name: Pearl
colors.role: Light body text for contrast pairs on dark surfaces

colors.name: Bone
colors.role: Primary headings, body text on dark canvas, button backgrounds - the sole light source

colors.name: Electric Blue
colors.role: Accent borders, glows, link underlines, badge outlines, active states - the only chromatic punctuation in the entire system

colors.name: Deep Current
colors.role: Dark accent fills and box-shadows paired with Electric Blue - the saturated shadow underneath blue glows

colors.name: Midnight Tide
colors.role: Subtle blue-tinted surface washes and shadow tints - keeps the blue accent feeling atmospheric even in flat fills

colors.name: Signal Green
colors.role: Green wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

colors.name: Vivid Violet
colors.role: Primary action button fill - the only place a solid chromatic button background appears in the interface

colors.name: Alert Red
colors.role: Red wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

colors.name: Amber
colors.role: Yellow wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

colors.name: Lime
colors.role: CSS token hint - secondary accent available in the design system but not actively surfaced in core pages

fonts.name: sans-serif
fonts.role: sans-serif - detected in extracted data but not described by AI

fonts.name: GT Walsheim
fonts.role: Display and heading type - the signature typeface. Aggressively compressed with line-height 0.8-1.1 and tracking -0.04em to -0.05em at 44-68px. This isn't decoration; GT Walsheim's geometric warmth at tight metrics creates the system's voice - confident, compact, slightly futuristic. Substitute: Inter Tight or Space Grotesk Bold for similar geometric presence.

fonts.name: Inter Variable
fonts.role: Body, nav, and secondary headings - the workhorse. Inter Variable's variable axis allows smooth weight interpolation. Tracking tightens as size grows: -0.001em at 18px to -0.027em at 22px. The variable version enables the site's fluid micro-animations. Substitute: Inter (Google) is a near-identical fallback.

fonts.name: Inter
fonts.role: Static Inter for UI controls, buttons (500/600), and uppercase labels (700 at 9px). Used where variable weight isn't needed. The 20px/600/lh=1.2 heading style with -0.04em tracking provides a compact sub-heading tier below GT Walsheim displays.

fonts.name: Input Mono
fonts.role: Code snippets, monospace tags, and technical metadata - appears in product UI screenshots and code-context moments. The mono voice contrasts the geometric sans-serif to signal 'this is structural, not prose'.

fonts.name: JetBrains Mono
fonts.role: Secondary monospace for code blocks - shares the developer-tool vocabulary with Input Mono but used in longer-form code contexts.

fonts.name: Inter Medium
fonts.role: Inter Medium - detected in extracted data but not described by AI

components.name: Primary Pill Button
components.role: Hero CTA - the only action that demands immediate attention

components.name: Ghost Translucent Button
components.role: Secondary action with low visual weight

components.name: Void Feature Card
components.role: Large content card - product showcases, feature highlights

components.name: Graphite Feature Card
components.role: Elevated card one step above void

components.name: Blue Accent Border
components.role: Active state, highlight border, interactive emphasis

components.name: Community Feed Container
components.role: Dark-window chrome for product UI embedding

components.name: Ghost Navigation Link
components.role: Top-nav items - Product, Community, Resources, Enterprise, Pricing

components.name: Blue-Tinted Deep Surface
components.role: Atmospheric background wash for accent sections

dos: Use GT Walsheim Medium weight 500 at 44-68px for all display headings - never substitute a different geometric sans-serif for display type
Set display headings with line-height 0.8-1.1 and letter-spacing -0.04em to -0.05em - the compression is signature
Apply Electric Blue (#0099ff) exclusively as 1px borders, glows, and link accents - never as a filled surface in hero sections
Use Vivid Violet (#0066ff) only for the primary CTA button background - it is the single filled chromatic button in the system
Set all buttons and tags to 9999px border-radius - fully pill-shaped controls are non-negotiable
Use card radii from the 15px 20px 25px scale - match radius to card importance, not to a single global value
Keep section gaps at 80px and element gaps at 10px - the compact density with generous section breathing is intentional
donts: Don't introduce additional accent colors beyond Electric Blue (#0099ff) and Vivid Violet (#0066ff) - the system is deliberately monochromatic with one accent
Don't use #ffffff as a background fill for cards - white is reserved for text and primary CTAs, cards stay in the #111-#242424 range
Don't apply box-shadows to standard cards - depth is communicated through luminance stepping (#000 #111 #171 #242), not elevation
Don't set body text below 12px - the minimum size protects readability against the dark canvas
Don't use warm grays or chromatic neutrals - the palette is strictly cool/achromatic in its grays, with blue as the only chromatic direction
Don't mix font families within a single text block - GT Walsheim for display, Inter for everything else, mono for code only
Don't use border-radius values outside the defined scale (8, 15, 20, 25, 9999) - every radius in the system maps to a specific component type
surfaces:
| Level | Name | Value | Purpose |
|-------|------|-------|---------|
| 0 | Void | `#000000` | Page canvas - the infinite black background |
| 1 | Graphite | `#111111` | Large feature cards and elevated panels one step above void |
| 2 | Obsidian | `#171717` | Mid-tier surfaces - content cards, button fills, window chrome |
| 3 | Iron | `#1e1e1` | Subtle intermediate surface for hover and pressed states |
| 4 | Slate | `#242424` | Input fields, elevated panels, highest standard surface |
| 5 | Midnight Tide | `#002238` | Atmospheric blue-tinted wash for accent sections and shadow tints |
imagery: Product UI screenshots dominate - framed in simulated window chrome with traffic-light dots, the embedded app screenshots become the hero imagery. Logo wall for social proof uses white wordmarks on black with generous spacing. No photography, no illustration, no abstract graphics - the visual language is the product itself, displayed as live interface. Icon style: minimal, outlined, mono-white at small sizes. Density: text-dominant with occasional large product screenshot breaks. The visual space ratio heavily favors typography over imagery.
layout: Full-width sections that bleed edge-to-edge on the black canvas, with content constrained to ~1200px max-width centered within. Hero is a left-aligned headline + single CTA pill, with the right side left intentionally empty - asymmetric, not centered. Sections alternate between type-only layouts (large headline + sub-text) and product-screenshot showcases. The 'Shipped with Framer' section uses a logo wall in a 4-column grid. The community section frames a product screenshot in a centered max-width container with rounded window chrome. Navigation is minimal - a thin top bar with left logo and right-aligned links, no sticky behavior visible. Section rhythm: generous 80px vertical gaps between sections, creating distinct islands of content floating in the void.
